albums.title: FaultLine / E1M1 · Skull relief and stencil shadows
albums.result: Fixed and deployed: legacy brush depth bias no longer pushes shell relief inside its own stencil shadow. Release build succeeded; engine SHA-256 6b9a3da267e343f1be526d1ccfb91dfab5a22382dd5ad19347bf04a437a595ec matches all three deployment targets. At 3840x2160, full-depth, scale 0.2, and hard-stencil skull cases exactly match their stencil-off and z-fix-off controls within the door crop (six comparisons, maximum difference 0); POM still changes 67,392 pixels versus flat. Mover fixture passed at rest, displaced, and returned: 14,552 / 24,147 / 14,552 shadow pixels; returned mask and world-only difference 0. Earlier POM floor camera still passes at 4K: 0 backstop changes or exposed backstop pixels across 5,088,027 pixels; 421,627 relief changes. First staged 4K launch lacked adjacent runtime DLLs and produced no images; checker reported missing inputs. DLLs were supplied, then capture and checks passed. Previous diagnosis failures remain in this album history. Default reversed-Z tested; compatibility depth path not retested. Shader cache retained locally to avoid repeating the cold compile. No map rebake needed. Source committed and pushed as 101f3e29.
albums.label: Fixed depth

results.text: Reproduced the reported skull-panel patches behind spawn at 1080p. Backstop, baked self-shadow, and SSR isolation did not remove them; disabling stencil shadows did. Disabling gl_zfix removed them with relief and stencil shadows still enabled. Cold startup was interrupted and retried with a shader cache; the initial close camera went through the door and was corrected. An experimental flat-receiver approach did not fix the patches; its initial GLSL reserved-name error was corrected. That broader experiment was removed. Final physical-depth fix remains under test.
results.label: Diagnosis

albums.title: Standard player ramp entrances and exits
albums.description: FaultLine E1M1 standard-player ramp recovery fix, engine 0.183.159. Screenshots show the actual authored ramp; chart measures full standing floor/ramp/wall traversals, including contact handoffs.
albums.result: Final shared release passes 596 actual-E1M1 movement checks and all four standing handoff comparisons at 144 FPS; camera velocity-change RMS is 50%, 90%, 55%, and 60% lower than the respective 0.183.158 baseline traversals. Standing camera probes are clear and offsets stay bounded. Initial candidate also passes all eight standing comparisons at 144/1000 FPS, 4,073 six-direction ramp checks, 48 ledge checks, 1,156 wall-run phase checks, and 88 smoothing-math checks. Engine 0.183.159 deployed to all three engine targets with matching SHA256 6b9a3da267e343f1be526d1ccfb91dfab5a22382dd5ad19347bf04a437a595ec; camera fix pushed on main in a98e8897. Initial link permission failure recovered. First final-release startup was deliberately stopped before map loading; the repeated run with a fresh shader cache passed. Automated improvements do not establish subjective MVQ parity. Crouch/slide viewheight steps remain a separate contributor.
albums.label: Released 0.183.159

results.text: Completed: standard and MVQ baseline traversals at 144 and 1000 FPS caps; standard candidate passes 757 and 591 movement checks respectively. albums.title: FaultLine / E1M1 · Mover bake allocation
albums.result: Fix deployed and pushed: completed poses are cached immediately; allocation failures retry unfinished entries with fewer workers while preserving resolution, bounce settings and pose sampling. 55 baker tests and 10 chart tests passed. A controlled interruption of a real OptiX worker retained 3/4 entries and completed only the missing entry with one worker. Current exported map passed a private fixed-4u/two-bounce bake: all 109 rest/pose entries, 75 playback poses, valid 16,800,013-byte atlas. Original allocation failure did not recur; user also reports successful recompilation. Four lighting workers used roughly 12 GiB of host memory. The coarse current-map bake also passed all 109 entries. Timing is excluded because recovery validation overlapped the full probe.
albums.label: Checks

results.text: Reported compile failure: geometry, VIS and static OptiX lighting passed; the four-worker mover-shadow bake stopped at 99/109 entries with bad allocation. Fixed 4u lightmaps and two-bounce PBR lighting; total compile time 4m 52.3s. Investigation and recovery fix in progress.
results.label: Checks
